items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: The first band I played with was, uh, George Colau. Yeah. Better known as Kid Sheik.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Uh huh. Well, when did you, uh, come to New Orleans?

I come to New Orleans in 19, uh, 19. Uh huh. Who did you, uh, who did you play with when, the first band? The first band I played with was, uh, George Colau. Yeah. Better known as Kid Sheik. That's him sitting right over there laughing.
Uh huh. Uh huh. Uh huh. Uh huh. Let me think. Uh, when was that? About what year?

items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: And, uh, so I got Chris Kelly with my band. Me, Chris Kelly, Eddie Summers, Leo Montrell, Phillip Gilbert

ctx.x: What were some of the places where they played that? Oh. Where Chris Kelly would be found. Imagine if there were tourists I got in 1927 in New Orleans, I'd like to hear Chris Kelly.

Well, he used to be down there. We used to have a place called the Sawdison, way down where the cattle would be at. A little room right down there next to the cattle pen, down Seminole. Go in there and play. And they'd play Flood Street. We used to have a dance in the mud out there. I was living on a marinerie between St. Claude and Rampart. A fellow that called Willie White. Used to have parties in his yard right next door to my house. And Chris Kelly used to play there. Chris Kelly used to come there before…

And in those days, um, who were some of your other favorite musicians? For example, who was your favorite clarinet player then? Or the one that made the strongest impression on you whom you ever heard?

items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: And Chic was the first one I played with in 1925.

ctx.x: I knew him before he died. I didn't hear him at about one time is all I ever got to hear him. Kid René, I used to go up there and play with him, Kid René.
Yeah. And Chic was the first one I played with in 1925. 25.

Well tell us about when you first took up music, about how old were you? You took up the bass you just told us you took the... No, no, I took up the bass. I used to practice on the bass when I was a little fella.
